enterprise.enterpriseName: Northern Star Airlines — Line Maintenance Amsterdam

commentContent.simplePara: The installation procedure tells the technician to tighten the four attachment bolts in the sequence shown in Figure 1, but the figure numbers the bolts 1, 2, 3, 4 in a diagonal order while the torque table in the referenced illustrated parts data lists them in a clockwise order. Two of our technicians have read the illustration differently.

We ask that the sequence be stated in words in the step itself, in addition to the illustration, so that no interpretation is needed. For example: "Tighten the bolts in the diagonal sequence: fwd inboard, aft outboard, fwd outboard, aft inboard."

No aircraft has been affected. The bolts were tightened correctly in both cases and the installation test was satisfactory. We raise this as a clarity issue before it causes an error on a line station without a supervisor.
